nodes.label: widget_phrases(p_token) function (016_widget.sql)
nodes.rationale: Only the sha256 of the token is stored in the database.

nodes.label: Stats layer (src/lib/stats.ts, tested)
nodes.rationale: Pure logic with no React and no DB so it can be covered by tests.

nodes.label: Widget connection code (base64url of {u,k,t})
nodes.rationale: No login in the widget; Lifegram generates a code with Supabase URL, public key and token.

nodes.label: Phrase rotation (screen off, tap, every 30 min)
nodes.norm_label: phrase rotation (screen off, tap, every 30 min)
nodes.rationale: A foreground service with a discreet notification is kept because it is the only way Android reports unlock.

nodes.label: PWA / iOS home-screen meta (viewport-fit cover, apple-touch-icon)
nodes.norm_label: pwa / ios home-screen meta (viewport-fit cover, apple-touch-icon)
nodes.rationale: viewport-fit=cover uses the notch area with safe-area padding; Safari ignores SVG icon so a PNG apple-touch-icon is required.

nodes.label: Desempenho area (/desempenho)
nodes.rationale: Area without history says there is nothing to measure instead of showing zeros, since zero looks like a bad result when it is really absence of data.

nodes.label: Double progression (load-up suggestion at rep ceiling)
nodes.norm_label: double progression (load-up suggestion at rep ceiling)
nodes.rationale: Hitting rep ceiling (default 12) on all sets suggests load + increment (default 1 kg).

nodes.label: Estimated 1RM (Epley formula)
nodes.rationale: Lets 60kg x10 be compared with 70kg x6; comparison with last time is won by higher 1RM so trading load for reps counts as progress.

nodes.label: Monthly progress via linear regression of 1RM (R2 consistency)
nodes.norm_label: monthly progress via linear regression of 1rm (r2 consistency)

nodes.label: Free static hosting (SPA, dist, HTTPS required)
nodes.norm_label: free static hosting (spa, dist, https required)

nodes.label: Supabase cloud sync (free, optional, magic link)
nodes.norm_label: supabase cloud sync (free, optional, magic link)

nodes.label: Timed and compound (block) exercises
nodes.rationale: Timed sets excluded from kg volume and not mixed with rep sets in records - 40s and 12 reps are different quantities.

nodes.label: Trail map - 500 levels in 20 chapters (src/lib/trackCarisma.ts)
nodes.rationale: Content lives in code and only progress goes to the DB, so new levels are appended at chapter end, never in the middle.

nodes.label: Weekly schedule and streak rules
nodes.rationale: Commitment is per day, not per workout; rest day always wins; bonus training never punishes; today only counts after it ends so streak never breaks mid-day.

nodes.label: Lifegram Frases Android widget
nodes.rationale: Minimal SDK-only app with no libraries.

nodes.label: Timer anchored to absolute instant
nodes.rationale: Recomputes end minus now every frame instead of decrementing a counter, so rest stays correct with locked screen, background app or frozen tab timers.

nodes.label: IndexedDB as source of truth (local-first)
nodes.rationale: Every write goes to an outbox queue and Supabase is updated later; no screen waits on the network, so no signal in the gym basement is a normal state, and a paused free-tier Supabase project does not break the app.

nodes.label: Fear score never drops automatically (reassessment suggestion)
nodes.norm_label: fear score never drops automatically (reassessment suggestion)

nodes.label: Areas registry (src/lib/skills.ts)
nodes.rationale: Creating a new area is adding one entry to the list; hub and Desempenho pick it up automatically.

nodes.label: Statistical honesty thresholds (src/lib/courage.ts)
nodes.rationale: Under 3 attempts no conclusion; 3-4 'data suggests'; 5+ trend; pattern analysis only from 15 complete attempts.

nodes.label: Two-stage attempt (predicted vs real score)
nodes.rationale: Prediction recalled after the result is contaminated by it, so prediction is saved before facing the situation.
